Is there an up or down inside the space station?

Inside the space station, there's no real up or down because everything floats! An astronaut can work upside down, sideways, or any way they want!
copy.tl:
Mayroon bang itaas o ibaba sa loob ng space station?

Sa loob ng space station, walang totoong itaas o ibaba dahil lumulutang ang lahat! Puwede pang magtrabaho ang astronaut na nakatiwarik, nakakilid, o kahit anong posisyon!
copy.bis:
Aduna bay taas o ubos sulod sa space station?

Sulod sa space station, walay tinuod nga taas o ubos tungod kay naglutaw ang tanan! Makahimo ang astronaut ug trabaho nga balintong, kilid, o bisan unsa nga posisyon!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: because there is no gravity to make it fall!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify gravity as a non-contact force that affects the behaviors of materials and objects on Earth in predictable ways
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions gravity and its effect (falling), but the competency focuses on gravity as a non-contact force affecting objects on Earth in predictable ways. The card describes the absence of gravity in space, not gravity's predictable effects on Earth. It does not directly teach the identification of gravity as a non-contact force or its Earth-bound behaviors.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: because there is no gravity to make it fall!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the effects of gravity to the motion of an object
assignedReviews.reason: The card references gravity's effect on falling, but it does not observe or describe the effects of gravity on the motion of an object in a direct instructional way. It only notes that in space, without gravity, waste does not fall. This is a contrast, not a description of gravity's effects on motion.

copy.en: The ISS toilet uses suction air instead of water to pull waste away, because there is no gravity to make it fall!
copy.tl: Gumagamit ang banyo sa ISS ng humihiging hangin imbes na tubig para hilahin ang dumi, dahil walang grabidad na magpapababa nito!
copy.bis: Naggamit ang kasilyas sa ISS og nagsuyop nga hangin imbis tubig aron birahon ang hugaw, kay walay grabidad nga mopahulog niini!
